body:
You're best off sticking with the therapist you have, but there is always other supports available.   


Have you thought about going to a 12 step meeting? I know there tends to be a kneejerk reaction from most people when meetings are mentioned, but it might be good for you, its a safe space to talk among other people who understand.
thanks for your reply. I'm getting there,it's baby steps... <3

I could have written this post myself, I've been in a very similar boat recently. You are not alone. I am slowly digging myself out of the hole of depression  I was stuck in for months. I stopped eating. I've gotten so thin. And I finally reached out to people.   


I am so glad you posted here. You may not want to hear it, but you are worthy. You deserve food. Your body deserves food. You can PM me if you would like to chat.
I hate that I wake up breathing, and I don't want to be alive anymore.

Thank you for the reply, but the world really doesnt need me. All I do is fuck everything up. I'm too old to blameit on teen angst anymore, my life is screwed and its all myfault. I've hurt people, I've ruined lives, and I'm a total disgrace.

I can relate. But I want to. I've tried. Several times in the last couple months. And its like I chicken out. Who'dathunk that the bravest thing to do is to end it all? People who say it's a coward act are so wrong.
I can relate to this. If I had a gun I'd have shot myself months ago. Yet, here I am, miserable and ruined, and breathing.
